map.由反电动势常数与角速度求反电动势: Find the back EMF from the back EMF constant and angular velocity
map.输入反电动势常数 k_e 与角速度 ω，求反电动势。: Enter the back EMF constant k_e and the angular velocity ω to get the back EMF.
map.📖 查看「由反电动势常数与角速度求反电动势 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the back EMF from the back EMF constant and angular velocity"
map.📚 深度解析：直流电机反电动势: 📚 Deep Dive: DC motor back EMF
map.电机转速反推电压。: Infer the voltage from the motor speed.
map.E=k_e·ω=0.05×100=5V；转速越高反电动势越大，限制电流。: E = k_e·ω = 0.05 x 100 = 5 V; the higher the speed the larger the back EMF, which limits the current.
map.E=10V，反电动势接近供电电压时电流趋小。: E = 10 V; as the back EMF approaches the supply voltage the current tends to zero.
map.反电动势作用？: What does the back EMF do?
map.与供电反向，E 升高使电枢电流 I=(U−E)/R 下降，自然限速。: It opposes the supply, so a rising E lowers the armature current I = (U - E)/R and naturally limits the speed.
map.k_e 单位？: What is the unit of k_e?
map.V·s/rad（或 V/rpm 需换算），由电机设计决定。: V·s/rad, or V/rpm which needs converting; it is set by the motor design.
